d:
NVIDIA has reinstated Jensen Huang as its President and CEO, reversing the uncertainty surrounding his leadership.
The company's board unanimously approved his return after a series of discussions and meetings.
The board said it received input from senior US government officials and found no national security risk in his reinstatement.
Huang thanked the board, employees, investors, partners and executives for their support as he returned to lead the tech giant.
Despite the controversy and ongoing investigation, NVIDIA has reaffirmed its confidence in Huang's leadership and vision.
